meta.note: 中英对照词典。from 为代码中的英文字符串原文(整串匹配,不处理模板占位符 $)。to 为中文译文。安全规则: 只翻译明确为 UI 文案的词条; 模型名/语言/主题名/SVG path/库错误不收录。

terms.from: Assert zero-data-retention and no prompt-training on every request, and let the gateway refuse rather than route to an upstream that honors neither. Some models have no qualifying upstream and are replaced by one that does, which can cost more \u2014 the config screen lists what changes.
terms.to: 在每次请求中断言零数据保留且不进行提示词训练；若上游服务两者皆不满足，网关将拒绝而非转发。部分模型没有符合要求的上游，会被替换为符合的模型（费用可能更高）——配置页会列出具体变化。

terms.from: body:"Just describe what you want. It reads your code, edits across files, and waits for your review before anything ships."
terms.to: body:"只需描述你想要的结果。它会阅读你的代码、跨文件编辑，并在任何改动落地前等待你的评审。"

terms.from: body:"Go from idea to done without leaving the app. Every change is yours to approve. When you're ready, Commit saves your work straight to git."
terms.to: body:"无需离开应用即可从想法到完成。每一次更改都由你批准。准备好后，Commit 会将你的工作直接保存到 git。"

terms.from: body:"As you code, it learns your patterns, tools, and conventions, then starts applying them automatically. Check Settings > Taste to see what it has learned."
terms.to: body:"在你编码时，它会学习你的模式、工具与约定，然后自动应用它们。可在 设置 → 偏好 中查看它学到了什么。"

terms.from: body:"Taste is learned per project. Open one to see what the agent has picked up."
terms.to: body:"偏好按项目分别学习。打开一个项目即可查看智能体学到了什么。"

terms.from: children:"Skills are instructions the agent reads and follows. Only install from repositories you trust."
terms.to: children:"技能是智能体阅读并遵循的说明。只从你信任的仓库安装。"

terms.from: body:"As you work, the agent records the preferences it picks up and they show up here. Or learn this project's taste from your past coding sessions right now."
terms.to: body:"工作时，智能体会记录它捕捉到的偏好并显示在这里。也可以现在就从这个项目过去的编码会话中学习偏好。"

terms.from: children:"Click a file link in chat or pick a file from the tree"
terms.to: children:"点击会话中的文件链接，或从文件树中选择文件"
